title: Chapter VIII — Offences relating to the Army, Navy and Air Force
context: Sections 159 to 168
text: Offences relating to the Army, Navy and Air Force VIII Abetting mutiny, and attempts to seduce service personnel from their allegiance.

title: Chapter IX — Offences relating to Elections
context: Sections 169 to 177
text: Offences relating to Elections IX Bribery, undue influence, personation and interference with election proceedings.

title: Chapter X — Offences relating to Coin, Currency and Government Stamps
context: Sections 178 to 188
text: Offences relating to Coin, Currency and Government Stamps X Counterfeiting coins and notes, possession of forged currency, and offences against government stamps.

title: Chapter XI — Offences against Public Tranquillity
context: Sections 189 to 197
text: Offences against Public Tranquillity XI Unlawful assembly, rioting, affray, and promoting enmity between groups.

title: Chapter XII — Offences by or relating to Public Servants
context: Sections 198 to 205
text: Offences by or relating to Public Servants XII Disobedience of law, framing incorrect records, and unlawful engagement in trade by officials.

title: Chapter XIII — Contempt of the Lawful Authority of Public Servants
context: Sections 206 to 226
text: Contempt of the Lawful Authority of Public Servants XIII Obstructing public servants, false information, resistance to apprehension, and attempt to suicide.

title: Chapter XIV — False Evidence and Offences against Public Justice
context: Sections 227 to 269
text: False Evidence and Offences against Public Justice XIV Perjury, fabricating evidence, causing disappearance of evidence, harbouring offenders, escape and bail-jumping.

title: Chapter XV — Offences affecting Public Health, Safety, Decency and Morals
context: Sections 270 to 297
text: Offences affecting Public Health, Safety, Decency and Morals XV Public nuisance, adulteration of food and drugs, obscenity, and negligence with fire or dangerous substances.

title: Chapter XVI — Offences relating to Religion
context: Sections 298 to 302
text: Offences relating to Religion XVI Defiling places of worship, outraging religious feelings, and disturbing religious assemblies.

title: Chapter XVII — Offences against Property
context: Sections 303 to 334
text: Offences against Property XVII Theft and the new offence of snatching, extortion, robbery and dacoity, criminal breach of trust, cheating, mischief and trespass.

title: Chapter XVIII — Offences relating to Documents and Property Marks
context: Sections 335 to 350
text: Offences relating to Documents and Property Marks XVIII Forgery, false documents and electronic records, counterfeit seals and property marks.

title: Chapter XIX — Criminal Intimidation, Insult, Annoyance and Defamation
context: Sections 351 to 357
text: Criminal Intimidation, Insult, Annoyance and Defamation XIX Threats, intentional insult, statements conducing to public mischief, and defamation.

title: Chapter XX — Repeal and Savings
context: Sections 358 to 358
text: Repeal and Savings XX Repeals the Indian Penal Code, 1860, with a savings clause for pending proceedings.

title: Organised crime — Section 111
context: New offence
text: Organised crime 111 Continuing unlawful activity by a crime syndicate — kidnapping, extortion, land grabbing, contract killing, financial fraud, trafficking, cyber-crime and more. Punishable with death or life where it results in death.

title: Petty organised crime — Section 112
context: New offence
text: Petty organised crime 112 The smaller-scale counterpart: theft, snatching, cheating, unauthorised betting or gambling committed by a syndicate. Up to seven years.

title: Terrorist act — Section 113
context: New offence
text: Terrorist act 113 A standalone offence of doing an act intended to threaten the unity, integrity, sovereignty or security of India, or to strike terror in the people. Death or life where it causes death.

title: Group murder on identity grounds — Section 101(2)
context: New offence
text: Group murder on identity grounds 101(2) Murder committed by a group of five or more on grounds of race, caste, community, sex, place of birth or language — the provision aimed at mob lynching. Death or life and a fine of at least ₹5 lakh.

title: Fleeing after a fatal accident — Section 106(2)
context: New offence
text: Fleeing after a fatal accident 106(2) A driver who causes death by rash or negligent driving and then escapes without reporting it faces up to ten years and a fine.

title: Snatching — Section 304
context: New offence
text: Snatching 304 Sudden seizure of movable property from a person or their possession. Up to three years on a first conviction.

title: Sexual intercourse by deceitful means — Section 69
context: New offence
text: Sexual intercourse by deceitful means 69 Obtaining intercourse by deceitful means or by a false promise of marriage, where the act does not amount to rape.

title: Acts endangering sovereignty — Section 152
context: New offence
text: Acts endangering sovereignty 152 Not strictly new — it replaces sedition — but the offence is redrawn around secession, armed rebellion and the encouragement of such feelings.

title: Attempt to suicide — Section 226
context: New offence
text: Attempt to suicide 226 Retained as an offence but reconceived: a presumption of severe stress, and a duty on the State to provide rehabilitation rather than punishment.
